gloss: to become ingrained; to soak in; to become a habit

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {染|し}み{付|つ}きませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {染|し}み{付|つ}いていなかった

forms.negative: {染|し}み{付|つ}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to become ingrained; to soak into; to permeate
definitions.explanation: For a stain, smell, or habit to become deeply embedded and difficult to remove. Used both literally for physical substances and figuratively for habits, memories, and ways of thinking.

examples.english: The smell of oil soaked in.
The smell of cigarettes has permeated my clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|し}み{付|つ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Years of habit have become ingrained in my body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|し}み{付|つ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Childhood memories are deeply ingrained in my heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧してきた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{付|つ}いて⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: After years of cooking, the smell of oil has soaked into the kitchen and won't come out.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE: ⟦{染|し}みる→染みる：10354_shimiru⟧ (to soak in/permeate) + ⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (to stick/attach)

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧).

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (-く type)
- {染|し}み{付|つ}かない (negative)
- {染|し}み{付|つ}きます (polite)
- {染|し}み{付|つ}いて (te-form)
- {染|し}み{付|つ}いた (past)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{付|つ}く - smell permeates
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{付|つ}く - habit becomes ingrained
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{染|し}み{付|つ}く - to become second nature
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{染|し}み{付|つ}く - memory becomes deeply embedded

USAGE:
Implies something that has become so deeply embedded that it's difficult or impossible to remove or change. Often suggests a permanent or long-lasting state.

WRITING:
Also written as {染|し}みつく or しみつく.

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.
